notes: INST token was rebranded to FLUID, no allocations changed
40M community allocation sent to DAO treasury at TGE, distributed over time
Airdrop tracks actual claims from genesis merkle distributors
~8.61M unclaimed airdrop tokens were returned to the DAO treasury
Community Incentives tracks treasury net outflows excluding airdrop distributor returns to avoid double-counting
DAO Treasury (TBD) tracks FLUID tokens still held by the DAO Treasury

Airdrop.methodology: Tracks claimed INST/FLUID airdrop tokens from the genesis merkle distributors

eth-airdrop-claims.name: Ethereum Airdrop Claims
eth-airdrop-claims.methodology: Tracks FLUID transfers from the 3 genesis airdrop merkle distributors (Compound, Aave, MakerDAO) to users. Excludes returns to DAO treasury.

Community Incentives.methodology: Tracks FLUID net outflows from the DAO treasury, which funds farming incentives and ecosystem grants

treasury-incentives.name: DAO Treasury Incentives
treasury-incentives.methodology: Tracks net FLUID outflows from the DAO treasury (0x28849d...). Inflows from airdrop distributors (returned unclaimed tokens) are excluded to avoid double-counting. Buyback inflows are subtracted.

DAO Treasury (TBD).methodology: 40M community allocation plus 8.6M returned airdrop tokens, minus the net outflows tracked in Community Incentives.

dao-treasury.name: DAO Treasury (TBD)
dao-treasury.methodology: 40M allocation + returned airdrop tokens - tracked treasury net outflows.
